messages:
emma (CS): Heads-up — Sentinel (enterprise) dedicated bring-up next Thurs 09:00 PT. Main asks: finalize quota windows, short smoke test, autoscale headroom for their large nightly import at +70m, and capture any renewal risk notes from the run. Who can own each piece?

diego (SRE): I can own autoscale/watch. Proposed staged ramp: 8m priming -> 10m @25% -> 15m @55% -> 30m soak. Autoscale rules: scale up on cpu_95>0.9 OR queue_ms>1700 for 3m; scale down after 12m stable below 60%. Add emergency surge rule for the import.

harper (Infra): Add KV prefix priming (5m) and warm the embeddings cache. We'll pin the model to sentinel-v2.1-quant for the first 24h, then allow auto-roll if CI evals pass. Also suggest limiting long-context uploads to 12 concurrent during first 2h.

sana (Solutions): Sentinel asks for a dedicated embeddings quota during first 60m and a short smoke at 09:30 PT (after warmup + initial soak). They also want the runbook to include clear rollback owners and a short note we can use in renewal health slides.

emma (CS): Diego — can you include a temporary surge multiplier for the +70m import (2.0x for 5m) and post the exact autoscale JSON to CS-7120? Harper — confirm model pin + concurrency limit. Sana — can you coordinate the smoke and capture any customer feedback items during the run? I'll draft a renewal risk blurb to attach to the onboarding doc.

diego (SRE): Pasting autoscale snippet to CS-7120 now (short form here):

```
{"scale_up":"cpu_95>0.9 or queue_ms>1700","up_cooldown":"3m","scale_down":"cpu_5<0.6","down_cooldown":"12m","burst_headroom":{"factor":2.0,"duration":"5m","trigger_point":"import_at_+70m"},"limits":{"min_instances":8,"max_instances":250}}
```

harper (Infra): Confirmed: model pinned sentinel-v2.1-quant for 24h; fallback prepared sentinel-v2.0-fp16. Long-context concurrency capped at 12 via proxy. I'll add notes and the fallback toggle link to CS-7120.

sana (Solutions): I'll run the smoke at 09:30 PT with Sentinel ops. Plan: 75 synthetic mixed-users for 8m focusing on chat + embeddings + a few long-context sessions to exercise the quota. Will record notes and capture any friction for the renewal pack.

emma (CS): Good — for renewal health slide, note: \"Onboarding status: on-track; observed risks: potential cost spike during imports (mitigated by temporary headroom), dependency on long-context throughput; mitigation: model pin + concurrency cap + post-cutover cost review with customer.\"

ops-bot: Ticket CS-7120 created: Sentinel dedicated bring-up orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7120

diego (SRE): Also recommending a short smoke script we can hand to customer to run from their side (mixed chat+embed):

```
for i in {1..75}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"chat","prompt":"healthcheck"}' & curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' & sleep 0.3; done
```

harper (Infra): I'll ensure the cache priming job runs at 08:50 PT and will pre-warm the control-plane toggle.

sana (Solutions): Sentinel wants to capture latency feedback for their UX team. Can we add a p99 and p95 latency export to the post-run notes?

emma (CS): Yes. harper — please attach the latency exports and any cost delta estimates to the ticket. I'll combine them with customer feedback items for the renewal pack.

harper (Infra): Will do. Also adding a short note in runbook: rollback triggers = sustained errors >5% for 10m OR p95>3.2s for 15m; rollback authority = diego (SRE) + infra lead (harper).

diego (SRE): Copy. I'll also add an automated alert to the oncall channel for those thresholds.

emma (CS): Final EOD checklist: 1) diego post autoscale + alert config in CS-7120, 2) harper add model pin + prewarm + latency exports, 3) sana schedule smoke with Sentinel and capture feedback, 4) I'll prepare a renewal risk blurb and send customer-facing timeline. Aim to close prep by EOD Tuesday. :thumbsup:

sana (Solutions): Scheduling smoke now; will update ticket when Sentinel confirms hold.

diego (SRE): Autoscale + alerts posted.

harper (Infra): Model pin/fallback and prewarm job added. Latency export will be attached post-smoke.

emma (CS): Thanks team. I'll assemble the runbook and post to the customer channel after confirmation. :white_check_mark:
